title: kate-lsp: frame a JSON-RPC message
summary: write_message writes a Content-Length header, a blank line, and the JSON body. read_message reads the headers, then the body, and returns None at end of input. Content-Type is accepted and ignored. A body that is not JSON is an InvalidData error.

lane.reason: Either lane may code this packet. It is one file, one behavior, and one test, and the rule text in this packet is the oracle. The first idle lane takes it.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: write_message serializes with serde_json::to_vec, writes the header with the byte length, the blank line, and the body, then flushes. read_message reads header lines until an empty line; a missing Content-Length is InvalidData; end of input before the first header byte is Ok(None); it then reads exactly N bytes and parses them; a parse error is InvalidData. The test a_message_round_trips writes {"id": 1} into a Vec<u8>, asserts the bytes start with Content-Length: 8, reads it back with a Cursor, and asserts the value; a second read returns None. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: jsonrpc::tests::a_message_round_trips
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because the functions do not exist. After the change a written body reads back and the end of input is None.
